_note: Adjudications for oldest-end batch 02, Aug to Oct 2023. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

reviews.note: Exhortation to praise.
Earliest grid telling located, Oct 2023, and it names five metros. Recorded prayer_may_prevent because he prays it down in the same breath.
Origin dated to 5 July 2023 by his own account.
Supplies the magnitude: submarine eruption, airspace closed, hundreds of thousands dead. One of the largest casualty figures in the corpus.
Not a claim but the confirmation he offers: a M4.2, the largest there in forty years. Note the gap between a 4.2 and hundreds of thousands of deaths.
Ted Cruz and a commentator speculating; offered as corroboration, not his own word.
Bundles the BRICS accession with the $200 oil figure; the BRICS half belongs to saudi-brics.
Intercession with a guest.
Revival exhortation. Kept for the aside that others were dating the return to September 2023, which he does not endorse.
His own account of method, and an explicit hedge: he sees in part. Worth keeping for the epistemics, not as a claim.
He marks this himself as an impression, not prophecy. Certainty recorded as tentative to preserve that.
Adds the flat statement that he is not believing for a near-term economic fallout. Sits against the December 2023 winter-crash claim three months later.
The full dream account with the count landing on 2 October 2023.
The date arrives and is absorbed: the Lord is extending more time. Recorded as a delay claim rather than folded into the original.
Earliest digital dollar telling located, and unusually modest: only bits and pieces in 2023, explicitly not the full manifestation.
Also carries an early instance of praying over Trump's life, which belongs with candidate-outdoor-attack.
Given explicitly as his opinion rather than as a word.
Adds the fall-feast window as a conditional, while restating that no man knows the day.
His reasoning, not a vision: the shmita arithmetic puts the tribulation about six years out from 2023.
Ties the April 2024 eclipse path to the New Madrid. Left unsure: it is an association he draws, not a stated quake.
Sharpens the window to March 2024 with a six to twelve month push, sourced to an article rather than to a word.
The standing exemption clause. Marked if_x on tithing, which makes any personal shortfall attributable to the hearer.
Closing exhortation.
Framing, and a deliberate refusal to date the return.
Rare admission that an earlier sense of imminence was off by a decade.
